fates.name: Answering
fates.description: Still raising steam, and still on the telegraph.

fates.name: Frozen
fates.description: Every building standing, every hearth cold. The winter took them in their beds.

fates.name: Overpressure
fates.description: A crater where the Steamforge stood, ringed with twisted brass. The salvage is rich and the ground still hot.

fates.name: Revolt
fates.description: Smashed automatons in the square and a burnt guild hall. Some of the people are still there, living rough.

fates.name: Abandoned
fates.description: Doors left open, carts gone, a note nailed to the Steamforge: 'Gone south. Do not follow.'

forges.name: Saltmarsh
forges.persona: Engineer Hesketh Moss, who writes in a cramped, coughing hand

requests.text: Our streets are black and our children cough. Send lung tonic, any you can spare. We will pay in copper.
The smoke kills the game and the hunters have no hides. Send coats before the frost.
Blight on the fields again. Tinned food or rations, anything that keeps.

forges.name: Brassmoor
forges.persona: Chief Engineer Augusta Pell, who writes in bold copperplate and never uses one word where three will do

requests.text: Brassmoor burns through coal like a furnace in a gale, which is to say magnificently. Send coal and we shall send you cogs of a quality the Board has never seen.
We are building a second boiler hall. You may contribute stone and share, in a small way, in our glory.
Our Steamforge runs hotter every month, Chief Engineer. Free steam! Send iron for more mains and we will pay handsomely.

forges.name: Frostgate
forges.persona: Matron Elspeth Crane, who keeps the Frostgate log and writes short, cold sentences

requests.text: Coal stocks at eleven days. Send coal before the winter. We will repay in iron.
Four lost to the cold last month. Coats, please. Any number.
The boiler is cracked. Firewood for the homes while we mend it.

forges.name: Gearholt
forges.persona: Overseer Jonas Grieve, who writes like a man with a mob at his door

requests.text: The Brotherhood is out again. Food will buy us a month's peace. Rations, tins, bread: send what you can.
Half our tools went into the river with the automatons. Send tools and we will send copper.
Bread for the strikers' families, or there will be no Gearholt by spring.

relics.name: Glimmerdeep's Frost Charts
relics.description: Forty years of winter readings. Your people know when the cold is coming: winters bite 15% less.

relics.name: Ironhollow's Governor
relics.description: The great brass governor from Ironhollow's Steamforge, fitted to yours: it raises a third more steam.

relics.name: Wending's Survey Lens
relics.description: The finest instrument the Company ever sent north. Research goes 20% faster.

relics.name: The Brass Heart of the Reach
relics.description: The master mainspring from the Reach's clockworks. Automatons work 15% faster.

relics.name: Lastlight's Flue Filters
relics.description: Copper gauze baffles for every chimney: the colony puts out 20% less soot.
